name: Black Bear Diner (Draper / American Fork) Slow-Cooked Pot Roast, Roasted Turkey Dinner or Sweet Cream Pancakes
brandOrRestaurant: Black Bear Diner (Draper / American Fork / Ogden, UT)
searchKeywords: black bear diner pot roast turkey
whyItWorks: Located right off I-15 in Draper near TownePlace Suites, Black Bear Diner serves homestyle Roasted Turkey Breast Dinner, fork-tender Old-Fashioned Pot Roast with mashed potatoes and cooked carrots, and "Little Less" smaller-portion Sweet Cream Pancakes & Scrambled Eggs all day.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order from the "Little Less" smaller-portion menu so you aren't overwhelmed by giant diner portions: choose Roasted Turkey or Pot Roast with mashed potatoes (gravy on the side) and a soft biscuit, or 2 Scrambled Eggs with 1 Sweet Cream Pancake.
watchOuts: Standard Black Bear portions are massive—order from the smaller "Grizzly/Cub/Little Less" section and ask for gravy on the side
